headline: Philippines and Japan Sign Agreement on Oil Reserves Cooperation
summary: The Philippines and Japan signed a memorandum of cooperation to assist in developing strategic petroleum reserve systems and energy emergency protocols.
why: Strategic oil stockpiles buffer net-importing Asian nations against global energy trade disruptions.

impacts.name: Philippines
impacts.why: Philippines secured Japanese assistance for national crude oil reserve development.
